title: 《rust》
logline: A two-hander about what rust does to the people who refuse to name it.

world.premise: A sealed residential block where rust has begun to appear on surfaces.
world.palette: warm fading stock, green-leaning shadows, milky blacks

visual_grammar.render: photographic, 16mm film stock with visible grain and gate weave
visual_grammar.lens: 25mm, moderate depth of field, occasional focus breathing
visual_grammar.lighting: available light, blown windows, halation around highlights
visual_grammar.negative: text, watermark, extra fingers, warped architecture, style change, clean digital sharpness, noise reduction, HDR, stabilised smoothness

C1.name: Wen
C1.locked_appearance: Late thirties, wiry build, black hair cropped short and greying at the temple, deep vertical scar through the left eyebrow, olive workwear jacket with a torn left cuff, always carrying a brass key ring on the belt.

C2.name: Lin
C2.locked_appearance: Early twenties, slight build, long dark hair tied at the nape, round wire glasses, oversized grey knit sweater with a stretched right sleeve, a red enamel pin on the collar.

L1.name: Stairwell C
L1.locked_description: A concrete stairwell with painted green handrails, one flickering tube light, numbered landing plates, and a steel fire door at the bottom.

L2.name: Unit 704
L2.locked_description: A one-room flat with a west-facing window, a folding table under it, a wall of taped paper notes, and an unplugged wall clock stopped at 4:10.

continuity_rules.text: C1's left jacket cuff is torn in every shot.
C2 wears round wire glasses and the red collar pin in every shot.
The wall clock in Unit 704 always reads 4:10.
Stairwell handrails are green; they never change colour.
Only one warm practical light source is visible per shot.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.logline: rust, one floor lower than yesterday.

beats.action: Wen stands still while the rust spreads across the far wall
beats.line: It started at the edges. Nobody looked at the edges.

beats.action: Wen forces the door open and finds the rust already inside
beats.line: You said this room was sealed.

beats.action: Lin says the thing Wen has been refusing to hear
beats.line: I knew. I have known since the first night.

beats.action: Wen destroys the one object that was keeping the rust out
beats.line: Then it was never the building. It was us.
